edits.old: Then the case record view writes no timer, deviation or case row and the escalation fields stay as they were
edits.new:
Then the case record view writes no timer, deviation or case row and the escalation fields stay as they were

  Scenario: AC13 Error answers of the timer and deviation operations (covers BR11)
    Given a caller without a valid credential
    When the caller calls "GET /cases/{caseId}/timers" on case "RW-2026-000501"
    Then the answer is 401 with Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P3-E2015-APP-AC13)
    Then a case outside the caller's scope is refused with 404 with MSG-P4-003 and not an empty list
    Then a role without Case record R is refused with 403 as in AC11

  Scenario: AC14 Downstream called once and timed out (covers BR12)
    Given the rwb-deviation contract mock does not answer within 2 seconds for case "RW-2026-000502"
    When "U-CO-01" opens the case record
    Then the deviation query is called once with no retry
    Then the timers and the prescription date still show and only the deviation section degrades

  Scenario: AC15 Disallowed status change refused (covers BR10)
    Given case "RW-2026-000501" has status "IN_PROGRESS"
    When a status change that the case status model does not allow is sent for case "RW-2026-000501"
    Then the answer is refused with Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P3-E2015-APP-AC15)
    Then the case status stays "IN_PROGRESS" and no case row is written
